Bluetooth SM Error Code

group BT_SM_ERROR

Bluetooth SM error code definitions.

Defines

SM_SUCCESS 0x00

Success.

SMP_ERR_SUCCESS 0x00

Success.

SMP_ERR_PASSKEY_ENTRY_FAIL 0x01

The user input of passkey failed, for example, the user cancelled the operation.

SMP_ERR_OOB_NOT_AVAIABLE 0x02

The OOB data is not available.

SMP_ERR_AUTHEN_REQUIREMENTS 0x03

The pairing procedure cannot be performed as authentication requirements cannot be met due to IO capabilities of one or both devices.

SMP_ERR_CFM_VALUE_FAILED 0x04

The confirm value does not match the calculated compare value.

SMP_ERR_PAIRING_NOT_SUPPORTED 0x05

Pairing is not supported by the device.

SMP_ERR_ENCRYPTION_KEY_SIZE 0x06

The resultant encryption key size is not long enough for the security requirements of this device.

SMP_ERR_CMD_NOT_SUPPORTED 0x07

The SMP command received is not supported on this device.

SMP_ERR_UNSPECIFIED_REASON 0x08

Pairing failed due to an unspecified reason.

SMP_ERR_REPEATED_ATTEMPTS 0x09

Pairing or authentication procedure is disallowed because too little time has elapsed since last pairing request or security request.

SMP_ERR_INVALID_PARAM 0x0A

The Invalid Parameters error code indicates that the command length is invalid or that a parameter is outside of the specified range.

SMP_ERR_DHKEY_CHECK_FAILED 0x0B

Indicates to the remote device that the DHKey Check value received doesn't match the one calculated by the local device.

SMP_ERR_NUMERIC_COMPARISION_FAIL 0x0C

Indicates that the confirm values in the numeric comparison protocol do not match.

SMP_ERR_BREDR_PAIRING_IN_PROGRESS 0x0D

Indicates that the pairing over the LE transport failed due to a Pairing Request sent over the BR/EDR transport in progress.

SMP_ERR_CRS_TRANS_KEY_GEN_NOT_ALLOW 0x0E

Indicates that the BR/EDR Link Key generated on the BR/EDR transport cannot be used to derive and distribute keys for the LE transport or the LE LTK generated on the LE transport cannot be used to derive a key for the BR/EDR transport.

SM_ERR_NO_ENTRY 0xE1

Host find no corresponding entry in the security database.

SM_ERR_DB_FULL 0xE2

The security database is full.

SM_ERR_INVALID_PARAM 0xE3

Invalid parameter.

SM_ERR_INSUFFICIENT_LINK_KEY 0xE4

Link key is insufficiently secured.

SM_ERR_INVALID_STATE 0xE6

Invalid state.

SM_ERR_NO_RESOURCE 0xE7

The security database has run out of resources.

SM_ERR_LINK_KEY_MISSING 0xE8

Host find no corresponding Link Key in the security database.

SM_ERR_DISCONNECT 0xE9

Pairing failed due to disconnection during the procedure.

SM_ERR_PARING_NOT_ALLOWED 0xEA

Pairing is not allowed when device is the Central.

SM_ERR_KEY_SAVE_FAILED 0xEB

Failed to save key to the security database.

SM_ERR_TIMEOUT 0xEC

If the Security Manager Timer reaches 30 seconds, the procedure shall be considered to have failed.

SM_ERR_UNKNOWN 0xED

No other error code is appropriate to use.

SM_ERR_LINK_DEACTIVATED 0xEE

Pairing failed because the link is deactivated.

SM_ERR_NO_PAIRABLE_MODE 0xEF

Pairing is not allowed when device is the Peripheral.
